Fetch Every Record Matching a Filter, One Page at a Time

Source: R/wildobs_dp_download.R
dot-wildobs_api_find_paged.Rd

Downloads a WildObs API collection in pages ordered by a key column, asking each time for the rows whose key sorts after the last one received (keyset paging). One unpaged request for many projects is too large for the API gateway to answer before it times out, and the API ignores skip, so paging on a key is the only way to keep every request small.

Rows whose key matches shared_key_pattern are fetched separately, in one request, and left out of the paging. This is for obscured threatened-species observations, which all share a placeholder observationID such as obscured_for_endangered_species: paging on a key that repeats would skip the repeats that fall after a page boundary.

Once every page is in, the number of rows is compared with the server's own count of the filter, and a shortfall stops with an error rather than returning part of the table.

Usage

.wildobs_api_find_paged(
  url,
  api_key,
  collection,
  filter,
  key,
  page_size,
  shared_key_pattern = NULL
)

Arguments

url

Character. The API find endpoint.

api_key

Character. The user's WildObs API key.

collection

Character. The collection to fetch, e.g. "observations".

filter

List. The project filter for this download.

key

Character. The column to page on; it must be unique apart from rows matched by shared_key_pattern.

page_size

Integer. Rows per request.

shared_key_pattern

Character regular expression, or NULL. Keys matching it are fetched separately and excluded from paging.

Value

A data frame of every matching record, or an empty list if there are none. Stops if the rows fetched do not match the server's count.
